conclusion.balanced_gate: Useful only as a weak-noise pre-filter. It removes 3 of 23 selected-unrelated visual candidates in prior set-2 diagnostics without dropping the 18 selected visual-evidence candidates, and reduces set-5 candidates from 14 to 12.
conclusion.not_sufficient: It makes no reduction on set 4 (32 to 32) because residual perspective/framing and generated micro-detail changes have strong numeric evidence. Raising thresholds reduces set-2 outputs sharply but still barely changes set 4, so a global numerical cutoff is not a robust false-positive solution.
conclusion.next_required_gate: First improve pose-tolerance/local alignment, then apply a spatial wire-zone/free-end/elongated-conductor rule after the balanced numeric pre-filter. Do not present these AI-generated-set counts as fault accuracy or use them to set a final production threshold.
